火灾斜线：USSBS 1946 年调查图，9 个桥梁控制点作仿射配准。边缘有旧测: Fire hatching: the USSBS 1946 survey, affinely registered with nine bridge controls. Edges retain survey, paper and scanning errors.
模型线：平坦地表、标准大气。没有逐栋建筑、地形遮挡或火灾传播。热辐射阈值表示单位: Model lines assume flat ground and standard atmosphere, without individual buildings, shelter or fire spread. Thermal thresholds measure received energy per area, not ignition or casualty boundaries.
超压：Brode 1986，经 glasstone 移植。热辐射：1987 苏联: Overpressure: Brode 1986 via glasstone. Thermal exposure: the 1987 Soviet clear-air nomogram via glasstone. A dash marks values outside the graph domain.
黑雨、沉降、中子活化: Black rain, fallout and neutron activation
黑雨是历史降雨现象，雨中混有烟尘等物质。放射性沉降是放射性物质落回地表，可随降雨: Black rain was rainfall mixed with soot and other matter. Fallout is radioactive material returning to the ground, sometimes with rain. Neutron activation makes irradiated surface materials radioactive. These have different boundaries; airbursts also leave residual radioactivity.

中国 596：1964 年。首次氢弹试验：1967 年。这里只记录历史，不展示内: China: 596 in 1964, and the first hydrogen bomb test in 1967. Historical dates only; no internal configurations.

底图按城市概览简化，最高源瓦片级别 13；没有复原 1945 年的建筑。: The basemap is generalised for a city overview, with source tiles through zoom 13. It does not reconstruct 1945 buildings.
其他国家暂为场址名录，没有把国家年度总数分配到这些地点；名录也未覆盖所有场址。: Other countries currently have a site directory. National annual totals are not assigned to these locations, and not all sites are covered.
「小男孩」的原理 · 结构示意: The idea behind Little Boy · Schematic
尾部的普通炸药点燃，像一门炮。: An ordinary explosive at the tail fires, like a cannon.
铀“子弹”沿炮管飞向前端。: The uranium "bullet" flies down the barrel.
子弹套上铀靶。两块单独都不够，合在一起就超过了临界。: The bullet slides over the target. Neither piece is enough alone; together they pass critical.
中子引发裂变，一代接一代，不到一微秒释放能量。: Neutrons split nuclei, generation after generation, releasing the energy in under a microsecond.
枪式结构简单，但合拢太慢；钚会提前起反应，所以钚弹要用内爆式。: The gun design is simple but assembles too slowly. Plutonium would react too early, so plutonium bombs use implosion.
用一颗原子弹，点燃聚变。: An atom bomb lights the fusion.
泰勒–乌拉姆构型的公开原理 · 结构示意: The public idea of the Teller–Ulam design · Schematic
初级先爆，它本身就是一颗原子弹。: The primary goes off first. It is an atom bomb in itself.
X 射线以光速充满外壳，比爆炸的冲击快得多。: X-rays fill the case at the speed of light, far ahead of the blast.
填充物被加热成等离子体，从四面压紧次级。: The filler turns into plasma and squeezes the secondary from all sides.
中心的火花塞开始裂变，把聚变燃料加热到极高的温度。: The spark plug at the center starts to fission and heats the fusion fuel to extreme temperatures.
聚变放出的能量可以远超初级，当量能到百万吨级。: Fusion can release far more than the primary, up to megatons.
中国在 1967 年试验了第一颗氢弹。它的具体构型没有公开，这里不画。: China tested its first hydrogen bomb in 1967. Its design is not public and is not drawn here.
示意，非真实比例。只画公开百科和博物馆层面的部件与先后，不含尺寸、用量和工程细节: Schematic, not to scale. Shows only the parts and their order as found in encyclopedias and museums; no dimensions, quantities or engineering detail.
